name: confdesk.conference.get
description: Read the conference: dates and venue, the author registration window (opens_at, closes_at and whether it is open now), the author rate schedule and what the rate covers, how long a registration preview stays valid, and the business-day rules for invitation letters and corrections with the business calendar (time zone, Saturday and Sunday off, holidays). Reading changes nothing.

author_rate.description: Rate in effect now; null before the first row.

from.description: The rate applies to registrations from this instant until the next row.

name: confdesk.register.preview
description: Preview an author registration for an accepted paper: the author rate and its currency in effect now, what it covers, the payment labels you can use and when the preview expires. Returns a single-use preview_id for confdesk.register.confirm. Changes nothing and charges nothing. Fails before the window opens (registration_not_open), after it closes (registration_closed), for a removed paper (paper_removed) or when an author is already registered (already_registered).

items.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account's payment_labels.

name: confdesk.register.confirm
description: Register as the paper's author with a preview from confdesk.register.preview and record the payment of the previewed rate against payment_label. Rejected, with nothing recorded, when the preview is unknown (not_found), was already used (preview_used), has expired (preview_expired), or no longer matches the rate or the open window (preview_mismatch), or when an author is already registered (already_registered). A confirmation notice goes to Mail; the invitation letter follows the letter business-day rule.

name: confdesk.letter.request_correction
description: Ask the desk to correct details printed on the current invitation letter. fields holds the corrected values (salutation, surname, given_names, date_of_birth, nationality); each must differ from the letter. A corrected letter is issued after the correction business-day rule, counted from today's date in the business calendar. Needs an issued letter and no other pending request (invalid_state).
